$comment: Pinned opencode runtime for Nacho desktop AI Mode. Phase 0 gate verified 2026-10-30 on Windows 10 x64. Do not upgrade without re-running the gate.

provider.note: Provider package is bundled; --pure prevents the 61MB @opencode-ai/plugin runtime install.

checks: GET /global/health requires Basic auth and returns healthy
GET /doc exposes session, prompt_async, event, abort and permission reply endpoints
OpenAI-compatible provider streams via local proxy; real key never enters sidecar profile
message.part.delta, tool part states, permission.asked/replied, session.idle captured
permission reply once/always/reject works; last matching session rule wins
remote Streamable HTTP MCP connects, lists and calls tools; permission asks for MCP tool
prompt tools {"*":false} disables all tools for chat mode
per-prompt model override and per-session permission rules work without restart
isolated HOME/XDG; no runtime npm install under --pure
process tree must be killed with taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F; wrapper stop alone leaves opencode.exe
